# xxHash

`xxhash.h` is the unmodified v0.8.3 header from
https://github.com/Cyan4973/xxHash/blob/v0.8.3/xxhash.h .
SHA-256: `17973c0dc49d9854ca26caa191f0e12f7a424b68858d9a78de3860d959d85e4b`.
The BSD 2-Clause license and copyright notice are included in the header.
The Linux renderer uses XXH3 to validate every byte of guest texture memory
on each use; this does not change replacement-pack identifiers.
